name: Qlucore Ab (Publ)
summary: Based in Lund, Sweden, Qlucore AB (publ) delivers advanced bioinformatics data analysis tools for global application in both scientific research and accurate medical diagnostics. Its product suite includes Qlucore Omics Explorer, an AI-powered bioinformatics software designed for research across various sectors such as life science, biotechnology, food, plant industries, and academia. Additionally, the company offers Qlucore Diagnostics, a specialized software platform for multi-omics companion and precision diagnostics, as well as Qlucore Insights, which facilitates the analysis of clinical data. Qlucore was established in 2007.
